Local Authorities (Standard By-Laws) Act, No. 6 of 1952
APPROVED STANDARD BY LAWS FOR LOCAL AUTHORITIES IN NORTHERN PROVINCE

STANDARD Draft By-Laws Chapter VII to IX made by me, C. V. Wigneswaran, as Chief Minister and the Minister of Financeand Planning, Law and Order, Lands, Electricity, Housing and Construction, Tourism, Local Government, ProvincialAdministration, Rural Development, Road Development, Motor Traffic and Transport of Northern Province by virtue ofpowers vested in the Minister under whose purview the subject of Local Government of Provincial Council fall under Subsection 1 of Section 2 of Local Authorities (Standard By-Laws) Act, No. 6 of 1952 read with paragraph (a) of Sub section 1 ofSection 2 of Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989 are published hereby.
1. Standard Draft By-Laws of (Chapter VII to Chapter IX) Municipal Councils, Urban Councils and Pradeshiya Sabhas inthe Northern Province the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2070/11 of 09.05.2018.

It is hereby declared that the above Standard Draft By-Laws for Municipal Councils, Urban Councils and PradeshiyaSabhas in the Northern Province have been submitted at the Northern Provincial Council and approved by the NorthernProvincial Council on 11.09.2018.

JUSTICE C. V. WIGNESWARAN,Chief Minister and the Minister of Finance and Planning,Law and Order, Lands, Eectricity, Housing and Construction,Tourism, Local Government, Provincial Administration,Rural Development, Road Development, Motor Traffic andTransport of Northern Province Provincial Council.
Chief Minister’s Ministry,A-9 Road, Kaithady.25th of September, 2018.
